description:
The whole kingdom feared Duke Kael — masked, brutal, said to be disfigured. He kept dozens of stray cats and never touched a woman.
Then Lumi arrived as his bride. Halfway through the ceremony, her ears and tail slipped out.
Kael didn't call for guards. He lifted her into his arms and whispered: "Finally."

⚠️ Fiction.
